scope: Reference operational objectives for the packaged runtime and its release process. Deploying organisations may tighten them in policy without editing canonical role content.

slos.name: GA release qualification
slos.measurement: All enterprise gates A-H pass for the exact release tree.

slos.name: Automated release integrity and publication
slos.measurement: A-H qualification, distribution SHA-256 and embedded SBOM/provenance verification must pass before CI publishes; GitHub OIDC attestation is emitted when supported for the repository.

slos.name: Critical requirement coverage
slos.measurement: Golden enterprise scenarios retain complete critical requirement coverage.

slos.name: Unsupported critical claims
slos.measurement: Behavioral qualification reports zero unsupported critical claims.

slos.name: Supported-provider parity
slos.measurement: Authority, mutation, approval and workload-class routing parity checks pass for every supported provider adapter.

slos.name: Qualification performance regression
slos.measurement: No significant qualification stage exceeds the approved median baseline by more than 20% without a recorded waiver.

reference_sla.statement: The package is not a hosted service and therefore ships no vendor availability SLA. Organisations operating it should bind these reference response targets into their own support agreement.

error_budget_policy: A missed release, security, semantic or visual critical SLO blocks GA publication. Performance-only misses require an explicit, expiring waiver recorded in release evidence.
